source.publisher: New York Times polling data / ElectIndex curated tables
source.notes: Descriptive poll observations only; release timestamps aren't supplied by these CSVs. First-seen timestamps are collection times, not official publication dates. Race observations retained up to 60 per race over a rolling 65 days.

changes.method: New observations compared with previous fetched snapshot; NOT a measure of electoral swing.

secondary_source.note: Source-attributed new polls missing from ElectIndex are included in live averages after identity, date, candidate, source-link and duplicate-ID checks. Posted dates are ingestion dates, not independently verified release dates.

secondary_source_retention.provenance: PollResults source-linked fallback; original first_seen_at retained
